title: PANIC → STEADIER
description: Understand the alarm, reduce fear of sensations, and practise steadier responses.

title: ANGER → CONTROL
description: Catch escalation earlier, protect the message, and reduce unnecessary damage.

title: OVERTHINKING → CLEARER
description: Interrupt loops, handle uncertainty, and recover attention.

title: SCATTERED → FOCUSED
description: Start, prioritise, switch and finish with less executive friction.

title: PEOPLE-PLEASING → BOUNDARIES
description: Say no, stop overexplaining, and protect connection without abandoning yourself.

title: CONFLICT → COMMUNICATION
description: Handle disagreement without attacking, disappearing or surrendering.

title: MANAGER → LEADER
description: Feedback, accountability, delegation and difficult conversations.

title: DRIFTING → MEANING
description: Values, identity, direction, acceptance and spirituality.
